name: Realm: cinematic fantasy (realistic)
description: Setting: a grounded, cinematic fantasy world photographed on location like a feature-film still - real weathered stone, timber, iron, fabric and foliage, natural and practical light with believable shadows and depth, true-to-life scale and atmosphere; any magic is subtle, a restrained glow or drifting particles that lights the subjects naturally; nothing from the modern world
notes: The realistic twin of realms/fantasy: the same fantasy backgrounds (backgrounds/fantasy/), described and lit like a film still instead of an illustrated D&D scene. Choose it per card (components.realm), per hero (art.defaultRealm) or for a whole group (_settings/studio.json realmByGroup). Angel Primes uses it by default to compare against the illustrated look.
